objective: Remove the height parameter logically without assuming finite zero counts, then isolate countability/multiplicity as an independent implementation layer.
target: For every nontrivial zero rho, Re(rho)=1/2.
bounded_predicate: For every nontrivial zero rho with abs(Im(rho)) <= T, Re(rho)=1/2.
bridge: RH iff for every T>0 the bounded predicate holds.
advantages: No conjugation or positive-height convention required
Separates logical global bridge from zero-count implementation
